notes:
**CHR-1047 — Agent skill section of the Connect AI tools dialog** (epic CHR-1045). Status: draft, waiting for design-reviewer and Christian's approval. Build ticket: CHR-1048.

## Goal
The user sees what the artisign agent skill does, can **read SKILL.md before installing**, copies `artisign setup --skill`, and sees per AI tool whether the skill is there. **Copy-only:** the preview never installs or writes a file (CHR-1045 decision 1).

## Screens
| Screen | Kind | What |
|---|---|---|
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog` | parent (changed) | tab strip added; MCP server tab active |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill` (+ `-dark`) | state of parent | Agent skill tab, mixed statuses |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-reader` (+ `-dark`) | step of skill | SKILL.md reader |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-all-installed` (+ `-dark`) | state of skill | every tool has the current skill |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-status-unavailable` (+ `-dark`) | state of skill | status could not be read; loading described in its notes |

Flows: MCP server tab ↔ Agent skill tab, Read SKILL.md → reader, reader Back / arrow → tab, Done → settings menu.

## Decisions (draft)
1. **Tabs, not one long dialog.** "MCP server" | "Agent skill" (`chrome-tab`). A second stacked section would make the dialog ~1000px tall in a 900px viewport and force scrolling inside a modal; tabs keep each view at today's size and keep the approved MCP content unchanged. Cost: the skill is one click away. The dialog opens on MCP server.
2. **Reader as a step, not an inline expander.** The dialog content swaps to the reader (640px wide, fixed 560px scroll area) with Back. An inline expander would have to share the 560px dialog with the command and the tool list and would leave ~250px for reading. Step keeps one modal and one scrim.
3. **Four skill statuses**, new `chrome-status-chip` variants: Installed (ok), Outdated (warning), Not installed (outlined), Not found (muted; tool not on the machine). "Not found" avoids two meanings of "Not installed" in one list.
4. **Claude Desktop** has no skills folder: no chip, `secondary-compact` "Copy SKILL.md" and "Download" in its row, plus a caption under the list saying it is uploaded by hand.
5. **No per-row actions for the other tools.** One command fixes every row (install and update), so rows do not expand; there is no chevron column in this tab.
6. Outdated is shown, not explained per row: `artisign setup --skill` (and `artisign update`) refreshes it.

## Data (from CHR-1046)
`GET /api/setup` → `skill: { command, content, clients: [{ name, status, path }] }`.
- `installed` → `installed`, `outdated` → `outdated`, `missing` → `skill-not-installed`, `unsupported` → Claude Desktop's Copy / Download.
- A tool that the MCP part of the same response reports as not found → `not-found` (row dimmed), whatever the skill status.
- Footer: "N of M tools have the current skill", M = tools found with a skills folder, N = installed. All installed: "All M tools have the current skill".
- `content` feeds the reader, Copy and Download (file name `SKILL.md`). Frontmatter is not rendered.
- No `skill` field (older daemon) or a failed request → status-unavailable state. Loading → same layout with "Checking installed tools…".

## Behaviour
- Copy buttons use `src/preview/clipboard.js`; the copy icon turns into `check` for ~1.5s (as in the MCP tab). "Copy SKILL.md" buttons change their label to "Copied" for ~1.5s.
- Statuses are read when the dialog opens; no polling.
- Tabs: `role=tablist/tab`, arrow keys switch; the reader body is focusable (`tabindex=0`) so it scrolls by keyboard. Esc closes the dialog from every view.

## Open points for review
- The dark `chrome-border` hairline is faint on `chrome-raised` (card, list and reader frame outlines). Kept as is for consistency with the approved dark dialogs (`chrome-c-dialog-dark`); a token change would belong to its own ticket.
- Claude Desktop's exact upload menu path is not named in the caption (it changes between versions).
